method: least squares through the origin, R_eff = sum(V*I) / sum(I^2), V = (mean shunt_raw - offset_lsb) x 0.01 mV, I = meter current; all four loads
offset_source: mean of the 2026-11-05 session zeros (start -2.41, end -2.474); VIN- open, Trace
offset_note: Default only. Each measurement session takes its own zero (record.py --zero) and runs are converted with the latest zero of the session.
note: Absolute uncertainty is bounded by the HM-1001 DC-current rating (about 1.2-2 percent in the ranges used). The 47 ohm point drifted (carbon-film heating), meter 95.5 -> 96.0 mA, midpoint used.
